source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.official_english: The 'SCO family' advances together on a shared path
topics.why_hot: This is the top-trending item on Baidu and centers on official Chinese messaging about cooperation within the Shanghai Cooperation Organization.
topics.share_angle: Explain the phrase 'SCO family' and why Chinese internet users are seeing this diplomatic theme at the top of the hot list.

topics.chinese_topic: DeepSeek被曝将采购16万颗华为芯片
topics.official_english: DeepSeek reportedly plans to buy 160,000 Huawei chips
topics.why_hot: It combines two names that dominate China's AI discussion: the fast-rising model maker DeepSeek and domestic chip giant Huawei.
topics.share_angle: Break down what a reported large-scale Huawei chip order would mean for China's AI supply chain.

topics.chinese_topic: 新能源汽车动力电池将迎“退役潮”
topics.official_english: Power batteries from new energy vehicles are set to enter a 'retirement wave'
topics.why_hot: It points to a mounting practical problem from China's rapid electric-vehicle adoption: what to do with large numbers of aging batteries.
topics.share_angle: Use this hook to explain China's EV boom and the emerging battery-recycling industry.

topics.chinese_topic: 生育险、长护险、医保报销迎新变化
topics.official_english: Maternity insurance, long-term care insurance and medical reimbursement to see new changes
topics.why_hot: Insurance and reimbursement rules directly affect household finances, and any policy adjustment quickly becomes a livelihood topic.
topics.share_angle: Explain the practical impact of these insurance changes on ordinary Chinese workers and families.

topics.chinese_topic: 长沙女子新房门窗缝隙能塞进4根手指
topics.official_english: Woman in Changsha says gaps in a new home's doors and windows can fit four fingers
topics.why_hot: A vivid housing-quality complaint is striking a nerve with Chinese internet users concerned about the cost and quality of new homes.
topics.share_angle: Discuss the story behind the complaint and what it reveals about home-buyer rights and construction quality checks.

topics.official_english: Psychiatric hospitals in multiple regions are changing their names
topics.why_hot: A wave of hospital renames around the country is prompting online discussion about mental-health stigma and public attitudes.
topics.share_angle: Look at why hospitals are rebranding and whether name changes can help normalize mental health care.

topics.chinese_topic: 上大学前几天档案被当垃圾扔了
topics.official_english: Student's personal record thrown away as garbage days before university enrollment
topics.why_hot: The news touches on a subtle administrative system that still matters a great deal in China: the personal archive that follows students into adulthood.
topics.share_angle: Explain what a Chinese student archive is and why throwing it away can create real problems.

topics.chinese_topic: 吉隆泥石流发生23分钟后航拍首次公开
topics.official_english: First aerial footage from the Gyirong mudslide released, shot 23 minutes after it began
topics.why_hot: Natural disaster footage is among the most-shared content on Chinese social media, especially when it shows the first minutes of a major event.
topics.share_angle: Provide context on the Gyirong mudslide and explain why the aerial video became a major point of attention.
